_comment: TC-039 / APP-05: the requests the analyze-lab-report Edge Function makes (service role) for one lab report. Pinned on both sides: supabase/functions/_shared/analyzeLabReport_test.ts proves the handler sends exactly these requests (real supabase-js on a fake fetch), and tests/integration/analyze-lab-report.test.ts proves the real migrated schema + storage accept them. Only the report id comes from the request; everything else is re-read from the row's real columns. {report_id} is the lab_reports id, {patient_id} its patient_id, {pdf_path} its stored object path. Results are filed in one transaction by lab_pipeline_file_results (service_role only); p_report.data is merged into the existing `data` payload and adds exactly the keys in analysis_file.data_keys_added (plus `date` / `lab_name` when printed).
